author: opencode-worker-1
text: Independently reproduced in the b7z9.8.1 security review (kimi-k3, 2026-08-31): node = qopts[i].value + 5 passed to s_provider->retrieve(buf, sizeof(buf), node) with no length and no guaranteed terminator (coap_dtn.c:218-228); any provider treating it as a C string over-reads the packet buffer. Adding cross-reference; no new bead filed.
